# [TASK] TMDB-shaped movie endpoints with read-through/save-through (movie-service)

## Task
Implement TMDB v3-shaped movie/genre endpoints in movie-service, with read-through/save-through so cached, persisted, and live responses are indistinguishable to the client.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Genre list, movie-by-category (popular/top_rated/upcoming), discover, search and movie detail (`append_to_response` honored) are implemented and TMDB-shaped (`TmdbFacadeController`; `TmdbFacadeIntegrationTest.genreListIsTmdbShaped`, `.popularListIsTmdbShapedAndKeyIsSwapped`, `.discoverForwardsFilters`, `.searchQueryEncodingSurvivesForwarding`, `.movieDetailsWithAppendToResponse`)
- [x] Recommendations and similar movies delegate to TMDB and upsert results (`MovieServiceTest.getRecommendedMovies_ShouldReturnRecommendedMovies`, `.getSimilarMovies_ShouldReturnSimilarMovies`) — no test exercises `TmdbFacadeController`'s `/movie/{id}/recommendations`/`/movie/{id}/similar` HTTP routes directly, see Notes
- [x] Read-through/save-through: MongoDB is checked before TMDB, results are upserted, and `page`/`total_pages`/`total_results` come from TMDB unchanged (`TmdbFacadeIntegrationTest.listResultsAreUpsertedIntoMongo`, `MovieServiceTest.discoverMovies_ShouldReturnPaginatedMovies`)
- [x] A second identical request makes no further TMDB call (`TmdbFacadeIntegrationTest.secondDetailRequestServedFromMongo`, asserts `verify(1, getRequestedFor(...))`)
- [x] Native `/api/v1` movie and genre endpoints still work (`MovieControllerTest`, `GenreControllerTest`, run on every push by `.github/workflows/backend-ci.yml`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 10

## Notes
Original design (ADR-003) stored raw TMDB JSON verbatim with short/long Redis TTLs. Superseded by ADR-010: a typed, persisted `Movie` catalog and a flat 5-minute Redis TTL as an L1 cache in front of MongoDB. Byte-for-byte TMDB replay (the original AC3) no longer applies under ADR-010 — `TmdbFacadeIntegrationTest` asserts TMDB-shaped fields instead of full body equality, which the criteria above reflect.

No test names the `/movie/{id}/recommendations`/`/movie/{id}/similar` HTTP routes themselves, only the service methods they call — a follow-up Task can close that gap.

Audit #274: `:backend:movie-service:test` could not be run this session — this sandbox has only Java 21 (`gradle.properties` pins `javaVersion=25`, and toolchain auto-provisioning isn't configured), so no backend module compiles here. Test names above were confirmed by reading the test source. `.github/workflows/backend-ci.yml` installs Java 25 and runs these on every push.
